answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.842 and sequence agreement is 0.344, both at or below the system-prompted range (0.861–0.908 and 0.31–0.48) and well below fine-tuned (0.900–0.938) and quantized (0.945–0.955). TV of 0.146 and Token-DiFR gap of 0.469 also sit at the system-prompted end, and the raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.6 fits system-prompted (3.3–3.9) and is too high for quantized (2.2–2.3). KL of 0.551 is above every category's range, but it points to the largest-change category rather than to a smaller one. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, because its raw-score ratio range is wide and its KL range is the next highest. However, its TV (0.076–0.099) and Token-DiFR (0.10–0.31) are far below the measured values, which rules it out.
